en.t: "Oh, ah..." the Master said in a daze,

units.source_text: “到这儿来的前一天，我曾去圣路加医院请大夫诊视，

en.t: "The day before I came here, I went to St. Luke's Hospital and had a doctor examine me,

units.source_text: 稻田博士也歪着脑袋说，‘心脏病未愈，这次胸腔内又有些许积水。’

en.t: and Dr. Inada tilted his head and said, 'The heart disease has not healed, and this time there is also a little fluid in the chest cavity.'

units.source_text: 来到伊东之后，又请大夫瞧过，说是患了支气管炎……

en.t: After coming to Ito, I had another doctor look at me, and he said I had bronchitis...
I suppose I must have caught a cold."
